A self-proclaimed time traveler from 2198 has made a series of unverified bold claims about the future

02:00 ET, 11 Sep 2026Updated 04:46 ET, 11 Sep 2026

A self-described 'time traveller' claiming to be from the year 2198 has delivered a startling prediction regarding an underwater find that will allegedly reshape the course of human history.

‌

The TikTok profile @timetravelexplorer has sparked intrigue with audacious claims that a creature, currently believed to exist only in mythology, living in the ocean's depths will be discovered within the next two decades.

The alleged time-traveling visitor has posted a timeline detailing when these discoveries will occur, beginning in 2044.

The clip, cryptically captioned "at least they exterminate them", has already racked up over 1,300 likes as the supposed temporal jumper left social media followers stunned with their most recent predictions.

The video begins by announcing that in 2044, "humans finally discover the ocean deeper", implying scientists will venture further into the aquatic depths than ever before, reports the Daily Star.

‌

According to the TikToker's narrative, three years later, "a creature that once was a children's myth becomes reality". However by 2054, multiple specimens of this species are found, leading to their extermination by mankind that very year.

Despite the supposed time traveller's forecasts, numerous TikTok watchers remain skeptical. One person remarked: "You do realise that since you told us this, you messed with the time and space continuum, so now it won't happen."

Another user chimed in: "You can say it to get attention but its not true," while a third asked: "How come the government ain't told us about you if you real?".

A fourth joked: "Ah yes, don't tell the FBI or something but make a TikTok."
